items.text: kal baad call karna
haan ji
thik hai
wait karna
aaj nahi
mein bol raha
roz call karo

items.context: Kab aap call kar sakte hain?
items.text: kal subah
shaam ko theek rahega

items.context: Aap kab free hain call ke liye?
items.text: dus baje theek hai
kal subah mujhe call kar lena please
baad mein call karo mujhe abhi busy hoon
aaj nahi kal raat ko call karein
shaam ke baad call kar dena mai ghar pe rahunga
kal dopahar mein call karna mera number wahi hai
abhi thoda busy hoon baad mein baat karte hain
kal subah 10 baje mujhe call kijiye please
aaj call nahi kar sakte kal contact karna
ravi ji kal ko call karna 2 baje ke baad
kal call karna mujhe abhi meeting me hun
mera phone abhi busy hai kal subah call kar lena
shaam ko baad mein call karo 7 baje ke baad
kal raat mujhe call karna koi dikkat nahi
kal 11 baje call karna please

items.context: Kya aap abhi baat kar sakte hain?
items.text: main abhi baad mein baat kar sakta hoon
kal 3 baje ke baad call karna theek rahega

items.context: Kya aap abhi call karna chahte hain?
items.text: mujhe abhi wait karna hai baad mein call karti hoon

items.context: Aapko kab call karna convenient rahega?
items.text: kal subah 9 baje mujhe call karo
maine apne account se paise katne ke baad bhi payment receive nahi kiya kal mujhe call karna
main abhi thoda busy hoon isliye kal subah ke time mujhe call kar lena
meri meeting chal rahi hai tu aaj nahi kal dopahar 12 baje mujhe call kar dena
kal mujhe office jaana hai to kal shaam ko call kar lena theek rahega
aaj zyada waqt nahi hai kal mujhe dopahar mein call kar lena main ghar par rahunga
abhi call karna mushkil hai kal dupahar do baje ke baad call karna
mera phone abhi busy hai isliye kripya karke kal subah 10 baje mujhe call karna

items.context: Kya main abhi aapko call karu?
items.text: kal aap mujhe subah 10 baje call kar sakte hain kya main abhi free nahi hoon
aap mujhe kal dopahar 2 baje ke baad call kar lena main ghar par rahuga

items.context: Kya aap abhi baat kar sakte hain?
items.text: main abhi meeting mein hoon isliye kal shaam ko call karna mujhe baat karni hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: callback_request - asks the agent to call back at another time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
